content: Play Data safety form: mandatory for ALL apps including apps that collect nothing, and a hosted privacy policy URL is required to complete it; developers are solely responsible for accuracy and Google takes enforcement action (blocked updates, removal) on discrepancies. Apple nutrition labels similar: 'Data Not Collected' must be strictly accurate; privacy policy URL mandatory. For BabyLog: no-collection claims are truthful only if no remote SDK, no crash reporting, and IAP purchase metadata is not exported by the developer.
